equipment_id.description: Identifier of the equipment the alert concerns

severity.description: How urgently the alert should be surfaced. Thermal excursions are always CRITICAL.

status.description: Current lifecycle status: OPEN, then optionally ACKNOWLEDGED, and finally RESOLVED or DISMISSED

triggering_reading_id.description: Identifier of the sensor reading that raised the alert

triggering_temperature.description: Out-of-range value of the triggering reading, in Celsius: its maximum above the range, its minimum below it; null for a DEVICE_OFFLINE alert

triggering_recorded_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the triggering reading was recorded

peak_temperature.description: Peak temperature observed during the excursion, in Celsius; null for a DEVICE_OFFLINE alert

opened_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) Timestamp the alert was raised

acknowledged_by.description: IAM user identifier of who acknowledged the alert

acknowledged_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the alert was acknowledged

resolved_by.description: IAM user identifier of who resolved the alert; null while not resolved, or when it was resolved automatically because readings returned within range

resolved_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the alert was resolved

dismissed_by.description: IAM user identifier of who dismissed the alert

dismissed_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the alert was dismissed

dismiss_reason.description: Justification given when the alert was dismissed

dismiss_evidence.description: Evidence given when the alert was dismissed

total_duration_seconds.description: Seconds between opening and resolution or dismissal; null while the alert is active
